about: One finding per hotspot read: the top 10 of the ranking, then #12 and #14 for milestone 3 (decision 0012 (d)), each written by reading the file at the blob named, not from its numbers. tools/health/hotspots.mjs joins these to the ranking and marks a finding stale when the file's blob changes.

findings.finding: one MonoBehaviour is the dial renderer plus every art spike as a `variant=` look (watercolour, roomlight, leafplant, soilmound, halo2, layout, and sprint, which stacks them) parsed in ApplyKey and switched by HasVariant :865, each spike with its own Apply step and fields, beside CPU halo-mask baking (BakeHaloMask :1896) and prefab mesh building (Build :1225, 166 lines); Apply :289 (140 lines) runs every step on every frame from SundialController.Update

PresentGarden decides the gap (`DaysSinceRitual(today) > 1`, :587) and waiting (`LastRitualDay != today`, :588) itself, a copy of the one-day grace in core Garden.VitalityForGap that JarRitualController :1265 repeats, so a change to the droop curve leaves two app copies behind; ApplyCaptureState :370 (173 lines) also decides which of twelve art-spike variants imply which (sprint turns on s5, s6 and s2b2 at :493)

OnIntent (114 lines, four deep at :812) is an if-chain on TargetId that routes the restore prompt, the continue prompt, settings pebbles, the voice shell, glad leaves, word stones and habits, so the breath ritual, two side rituals, settings, voice and first run share one class of 56 private fields; Update :457 (116 lines) carries the pause machine that DuskRitualController copies

core documents a plant's Stage as only rising (Growth.cs:14) but derives it from live kept days, which an undo or a day shift lowers; PushView :597 (68 lines, four deep at :642) patches that with its own session-only floor (`_stageFloor` :87, :633) keyed by slot arc*3+row, not by habit id, so the honest-growth guarantee lives in app code and resets on restart

CreateLibrary (326 lines) authors every jar material inline (221 `m.Set` lines in the file) and types the locked colours a second time beside JarView's constants (moss emission and rim :345 and :346 against JarView :75 and :76, glass volume and streak :331 and :335 against JarView :361 and :363), so a retune in one leaves the other behind; no test names JarSetup

beside the prefab build the class carries one-off capture tools: BoilSequence :163 and HaloReel :208 are the same 40-line body with a different frame count and rate, AstcInkCheck :91 writes into orchestration/runs/sundial/T-SUN-007 (untracked since e3a8abe), and its camera and plate helpers (:880 to :949) re-implement CaptureCli's private ones; no test names DialSetup

the class uses no UnityEngine at all, yet its rules (focus hours, deferred tends, arc dragging, the day-shift guard :484, habit admission) are reached only by Unity PlayMode tests, so none of it runs under dotnet test; TryRestoreBackup :400 also retypes SaveStore's file names (save.prev1.json, save.snapshot.json) and copies without the schema check that Terrarium's GardenService.TryRestore :299 makes

Update :149 holds a second copy of JarRitualController's pause machine (_latchedPause, _needFreshPinch, _sawOpen, _awaitContinue, _pausedFor and ContinueAfterSeconds = 60 at :23; compare JarRitualController :488 to :533), so PLAN S4's 'a ritual cut off is offered back, never auto-restarted' lives twice in app code and in neither core nor BreathSession; OnIntent :227 also asks the sibling StretchRitualController whether it claims a palm

on a failed load the restore pinch calls `_service.TryRestoreBackup()` and drops its result; that method copies the backup over save.json and leaves the reload to its caller, but nothing rebuilds the SundialService (created once in SundialController.Awake :228), so by reading, Outcome stays Failed and the restore prompt stays up until the app restarts; FirstRunTests :134 checks only that the prompt shows (not run here: PlayMode needs a Unity licence)

DoShot (94 lines) parses arguments, opens the scene, applies state, builds the camera and plate, renders, composites the overlay and writes the check json, the orbit turns and the side-by-side in one body; its camera and plate helpers are private (AttachPlate :279, LoadPlate :326, DisableWorldPlates :432), so DialSetup :880 to :949 re-implements them and nine Sundial PlayMode tests each declare their own AttachPlate; no test names CaptureCli

the habit and tend row codec (HabitKnown :158, TendKnown :163, ReadHabit :264, WriteHabit :280, ReadTend :296, WriteTend :312, KeepExtra :328, RestoreExtra :335, HabitKey :342, StringMember :348, EnumMember :354; 97 non-blank lines) is typed a second time as private members of SundialSave.cs (#14, :58 to :66, :167 to :239, :313 to :325), and the copies have drifted: a null Group is written null here (:286) and '' there (SundialSave :192); Row is known there (:60, :176) and passes through here as an unknown member; an unreadable tend Source falls back to Ritual here (:304) and Pinch there (:213); a row with no Id keeps its unknown members here under a '#index' key (HabitKey :342) and loses them there (SundialSave :181, :218). As the core copy, this one owns the rule. Refactor: a core step A adds one public row codec (a new type under a name no app type uses, e.g. LedgerJson) holding these members, with the Group null rule, the Source fallback and Row as arguments; then these private members call it with Terrarium's choices. Qualifies under 0012 (c): only private members change; Read :69, Write :111, ToJson :59, FromJson :64, HabitExtra :56 and TendExtra :57 keep their signatures and, with Terrarium's choices passed, the text they write byte for byte; but GardenVR.Core has no approved-surface reflection test yet (only GardenVR.SundialModel.Tests has one), so condition 1 needs that test committed first, and the step A adds the new type to its list. Unity-only callers of the members the refactor runs through: GardenService.cs:76 and :77 (Read and Write handed to SaveStore), GardenService.cs:305 (FromJson in TryRestore), and PlayMode ToJson at OneWordPlaybackTests.cs:106 and :164, ThreeGoodThingsPlaybackTests.cs:92 and :117, GatePlaybackTests.cs:324, JourneyTests.cs:416; nothing under apps/ reads TerrariumSave's HabitExtra or TendExtra. Pinned by TerrariumSaveTests :9 (round trip, same text), :65 (unknown members on the root, a habit, a tend and settings, HabitExtra['h']), :86, :114, :136, :159, :187, OneWordTests :119 and :144, ThreeGoodThingsTests :134. The refactor adds a core test that writes one habit row and one tend row, with and without an Id, under each app's choices and asserts the text each codec writes today. Expected: TerrariumSave.cs about 90 code lines fewer (322 to about 230), one new core file of about 100; row codec sites 2 to 1 once #14 adopts it. Seen, not part of this refactor: ReadWords :218 calls AsObject on each DayWords row, so one row that is not an object throws and fails the whole load, where SundialSave's ReadGratitude :247 skips such a row

defect, by reading: ReadSettings :136 keeps no unknown member and WriteSettings :152 writes only its nine, and ReadFocus :282 and WriteFocus :298 do the same, so a Settings or Focus member this build does not know (one a newer build adds at schema 1, the way Terrarium added BoxPace) is gone after the next save, against the promise at :27 and against TerrariumSave's SettingsExtra (TerrariumSave.cs :55, :176, :208); a Focus that is not an object is dropped too, because 'Focus' is always in RootKnown (:50), where a Gratitude that is not an array stays in Extra (:53, :75). Duplicated rule: the habit and tend row codec (HabitKnown :58, TendKnown :63, ReadHabit :167, WriteHabit :186, ReadTend :205, WriteTend :223, StringMember :313, EnumMember :319; 90 non-blank lines) is TerrariumSave's private copy (#12) with four drifts, one of them a loss: a row with no Id drops its unknown members here (:181, :218; TerrariumSave keys it '#index', :342). The schema number 1 is also typed at :31, :72 and :111 beside SundialService.SchemaVersion (SundialService.cs:57). Refactor, two parts. (1) Qualifies under 0012 (c), after #12's core step A: the private row members call the core row codec with this file's choices (Group null written '', Source fallback Pinch, Row known) and :31, :72, :111 read SundialService.SchemaVersion; no line of PublicSurface.approved.txt changes (SundialCodec.Read and Write at :52 and :53, SundialSave at :54 to :64), and the only change in output is that an id-less row keeps its unknown members, an effect on disk that only the next launch reads. SundialCodec has no Unity-only caller: its one caller is SundialService.cs:126, which dotnet compiles. Unity-only readers of the document Read returns: RimScrubController.cs:227 and :233, WeekDialController.cs:334, and PlayMode ArcTimesTests.cs:134 and :135, FirstRunTests.cs:90 and :106, TendPlaybackTests.cs:183, which read Habits, Settings and FirstRunStep, values part 1 keeps. (2) Does not qualify: keeping unknown Settings and Focus members needs a new public field (a SettingsExtra like TerrariumSave :55, and one for Focus), a surface change, so it is a step B for 0012 (a). Pinned by SundialSaveTests :10 (full round trip, second pass same text), :66 (unknown root and habit members), :76 (gratitude rows), and SundialRestoreTests :40 and :63 and SundialServiceTests through the store. The refactor adds a test that an id-less habit row and an id-less tend row keep an unknown member, and a golden text of today's output for one full document, so byte identity is pinned across the move (the round trip at :10 compares the new code with itself). Expected: SundialSave.cs about 80 code lines fewer (295 to about 215); duplicate rule sites: row codec 2 to 1, extras key rule 2 to 1, schema number 4 to 1

notes: Scan-sweep ledger checked: `.claude/scan-history/` of the main checkout (git-ignored; 2026-10-05, rounds 1 to 6). Its five open findings sit in `Ledger.cs` (two), `Json.cs`, `KbmIntentMapper.cs` and `Framing.cs`, none of them a top-10 file, and none overlaps a finding above, so nothing here is marked *backlogged* and nothing there is raised again.
The round notes of that ledger also leave `Garden.Serialize`/`Deserialize` with no caller outside tests and `Plant.CanBackfillYesterday` ignoring `ArchivedDay`; neither file is in the top 10.

Milestone 3 refactors the top 3 under tests. The only test files that name `DialView`, `JarView` and `JarRitualController` are Unity EditMode and PlayMode tests, which need a Unity licence this machine lacks; `dotnet test shared/core-dotnet` covers none of them.

#7 SundialService.cs: its finding was read at blob e54a886b03. The engine-free-rules half was closed by a39cbdf (the file now runs under dotnet test: GardenVR.SundialModel.csproj:12, SundialServiceTests), and the retyped-names restore by c0d7d9a (TryRestoreBackup :406 calls SaveStore.Restore, SundialRestoreTests). Read at 3f6fbc872b, three things are left. (1) BackfillOffered :546 ends the window at GardenDay.DefaultBoundary (:553), and BackfillYesterday :561 goes through SundialRules.Backfill (SundialRules.cs:141), whose Ledger.Backfill overload also uses 03:00 (Ledger.cs:129), while Today() :579 uses the saved BoundaryMin (Boundary :584); with a saved boundary of 04:00, yesterday's backfill closes at 03:00, an hour before the garden day ends. No app code writes BoundaryMin, so only a hand-edited or newer save reaches it. The fix needs a core overload of SundialRules.Backfill with a boundary (step A), then the service passes Boundary; it changes what SundialController.cs:895, :930 and :945 read in the same session, so the service half is a step B. It is a sibling of the open scan-sweep finding 'DeferredTend.Commit ignores a non-default garden-day boundary' (Ledger.cs), at a different site, and is not that finding raised again. (2) The default 180 is typed three times (:588, :589, SundialSave.cs:10) beside SundialRules.DayBoundaryMin. (3) TryRestoreBackup still does not adopt the restored document: Outcome (:79) stays Failed until a restart, which FirstRunWizard.cs:220 and :223 need; Bind :132 could take the restore result, but FirstRunWizard reads Outcome in the same session (:90, :110, :175, :220, :269), so that half of proposal 2 stays a step B with FirstRunWizard.cs:218-225.
